_comment: Connect & Organize demo video composition (#59). DRAFT: not approved for publication (blocked by #44 and communications/release-checklist.md Release B). Read by demo/organize-campaign.mjs and tests/test_organize_campaign.py. Times are seconds. Every 'network' segment of a variant comes from ONE continuous browser take: each segment starts at its planned time, its actions run in the real UI and wait for the app's own confirmation, and the render fails if an action does not finish inside its segment.
data_source: The four fictional '(Demo)' researchers of demo/synthetic.mjs (DOIs under Crossref's 10.5555 test prefix), served in place of pub.orcid.org inside the recording browser. Each take uses a fresh, empty browser profile, so no real workspace, contact or note can appear. Every other external request is blocked and listed in the render manifest.

audio._comment: Off by default. No narration or music asset is included in the repository; pass --narration=<file> or --music=<file> to mix one in.

required_captions: Your notes stay in this browser by default
Curated membership/project attribution is not independently verified

demo._comment: Typed live during the take. People are referenced by index into demoPeople of demo/synthetic.mjs (0 Ada, 1 Sam, 2 Lena, 3 Noor).
demo.handoff_note: Asked how the group shares metadata.
demo.note: Wants to share home-cage data. Met at the poster session.
